newsitem.title: USA: Ruddick Corp names Dickson president.
newsitem.headline: Ruddick Corp names Dickson president.

text.p: Ruddick Corp on Monday said its directors elected Thomas Dickson as president of the company.
Dickson succeeds John Copeland who had announced his retirement. Copeland will continue to serve as a director.
Dickson was previously executive vice president of Ruddick and president of American & Efird Inc, a Ruddick subsidiary, which he joined in 1980.
Ruddick's two subsidiaries are American & Efird, which makes industrial sewing thread, and Harris Teeter Inc, which operates a chain of supermarkets in five southeastern U.A. states.
